title: MOOR Worker Response SOP
purpose: Bind human-facing worker claims to actual pipeline evidence so parallel chats cannot accidentally tell Sebastian that work is done, pushed, in Pulse, or verified before those states are true.

authority_model.note: This SOP governs reporting language only. It cannot mint Funnel/build/release authority.

states.evidence: Valid sealed Funnel receipt or verified Funnel replay exists.
Executable artifact/code exists in the worker's current branch or artifact location.
Requested-path tests/CI/inspection actually ran and passed.
forbidden_claims: done unless all requested destinations are also satisfied

states.evidence: Git host reports merge to canonical target branch with commit SHA.
forbidden_claims: in Pulse unless registry/manifest evidence exists
owner-visible unless openable canonical destination exists

states.evidence: Current main contains the Pulse registry/manifest/rebuild-preservation entry and target artifact.
forbidden_claims: owner-visible unless the owner can locate/open it
deployed/live if Pages/runtime was not checked

states.evidence: Named canonical destination is openable/findable by Sebastian and evidence links exist in Dev Feed or the explicit destination.
allowed_claims: you can find it in Pulse
done for the requested owner-visible scope

states.evidence: Actual runtime/deployment path was independently checked after release.
forbidden_claims: production-ready unless production acceptance criteria also passed

wording_rules: Never use 'pushed to Pulse' as shorthand for 'file exists in repository'. Pulse requires actual registry/manifest/rebuild-preservation evidence.
Never use 'done' without naming the highest proven state and any remaining gaps.
A PR being open is not a merge.
A passing unit test is not requested-path verification unless it actually exercises that path.
A Pulse component registration is not proof that GitHub Pages or another deployment has updated.
If the worker discovered a mismatch between a previous claim and evidence, say so explicitly and append a correction event; do not silently rewrite history.
When another repository is the canonical destination, name that repository instead of saying 'Pulse' unless a Pulse representation also exists.
When evidence is incomplete, report the incomplete state rather than filling the gap with confidence.

optional: Where the owner can open it

minimal_examples.branch_only: Implemented on branch X. Not yet verified or merged.
minimal_examples.verified_pr: Implemented and CI-verified in PR #N. Not merged yet.
minimal_examples.merged_not_pulse: Merged to main at SHA. It is not registered in Pulse.
minimal_examples.pulse_registered: Merged and registered in Pulse. Runtime deployment was not independently checked.
minimal_examples.owner_visible: Merged, Pulse-registered, and owner-visible at [component]. CI passed. No live-backend/deployment claim beyond that.

correction_protocol: Identify the exact earlier claim that exceeded evidence.
State what evidence actually existed at that time.
State the corrected claim that should have been used.
If the gap is now fixed, append that later state separately rather than pretending the earlier claim was true.
Write the correction into Dev Feed when it materially affects owner understanding.
